;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)]]
**Six [[United States|U.S.]] air strikes over the weekend kill at least 62 [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants in [[Somalia]], according to [[The Pentagon]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46592101 (BBC)]
*Two [[Scandinavia]]n women on a backpacking holiday were found dead in [[Morocco]] with cuts to their necks. The bodies were found in an isolated area in the [[Atlas Mountains]], near the tourist village of [[Imlil, Marrakesh-Safi]]. 13 men are arrested with links to a Jihadist group. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/20/morocco-killing-of-scandinavian-women-linked-to-militants-says-prosecutor (''The Guardian'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Miss Universe 2018]]
**[[Catriona Gray]] from the [[Philippines]] is crowned [[Miss Universe]] at the [[Impact, Muang Thong Thani|IMPACT Arena]] in [[Thailand]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/style/article/miss-universe-2018-catriona-gray/index.html (CNN)]

;Business and economy
*[[Fee|Tolls]] are scrapped for the [[Severn crossing]] [[Toll bridge|bridge]]s connecting [[England]] and [[South Wales]], making travel across the [[River Severn]] free for all commuters for the first time in 800 years. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-46539168 (BBC)]


;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Poland]]
**[[President of Poland|Polish President]] [[Andrzej Duda]] signs into law the bill, passed by the [[Parliament of Poland]]  three weeks ago, reinstating the [[Supreme Court of Poland|Supreme Court]] judges who  had been forced out of their jobs when legislation to lower the judges's mandatory retirement age was enacted in July. This addresses one of the issues that has been in dispute with the [[Court of Justice of the European Union|European Union]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/12/17/world/europe/poland-supreme-court.html (''The New York Times'')]

*160 million-year-old [[fossil]] [[anurognathid]] [[pterosaur]]s are discovered that show [[feather]]y coverings, suggesting either deep common ancestry with [[theropod]] [[dinosaur]]s or independent [[coevolution]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-46572782 (BBC)] [https://www.nature.com/articles/s41559-018-0728-7 (''Nature'')]
